name: Nordmann fir
desc: A tall mountain conifer growing at roughly 900 to 2,200 m. The Caucasus reserve was founded in 1924 partly to protect its giant firs.
about: Abies nordmanniana, the Nordmann fir or Caucasian fir, is a fir indigenous to the mountains south and east of the Black Sea, in Turkey, Georgia and the Russian Caucasus.
